name: 60560 · Yorkville, IL
findings: ZIP 60560 (Yorkville) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60560 (Yorkville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
